notes: Hit reaction clock is independent of movement, fire and reload clocks.
Draw the phase-specific body using the current movement frame. Move rear/front overlays one pixel opposite body facing during impact/flinch.
Apply the damage tint to the assembled actor silhouette for the first 40 ms.
Recovery uses the current normal body and action frames, never a restart of their animations.
The eight hurt tags are editable ready-pose examples, not gameplay state locks.
Trigger only when game logic accepts a damaging hit; animation timing does not change invulnerability.

name: Hype Man — complete combat animation set

notes: The ability effect is immediate. The gesture is cosmetic and can be interrupted by firing, reload or dodge.
Draw gesture-rear, then lower from the current movement frame, then upper from the gesture frame.
The radial pulse is independent and continues when the gesture is interrupted.
Four body views and eight weapon aim angles. North uses the back body, south the front body, diagonals retain the side three-quarter views.
Retain separate body/action clocks and draw rear, body, front with the movement bob.
Dodge art is 510 ms, mapped to the 380 ms gameplay roll.
Death plays once and holds until restart.
All native frames use the approved palette and binary transparency.
spriteScale: Original character pixels, plus 8 pixels of horizontal padding on each side
